channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: The blockchain network fixed several open research items, added more testing, and refreshed documentation, while a downgrade feature for interlock gates was introduced and escrow‑release documentation was updated. The SDK received a hardening update and the cognitive system added a keystore concurrency test. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusSDK, openapi-client-scaffold, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: New research phases and prototype fixes were added to the blockchain network, along with component upgrades and tests to persist verification items. Documentation was clarified and updated, and a seal‑growth harness was added to the network. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: The blockchain network revised plans after feedback, added new phase documentation, and the SDK improved pagination handling and added tests. An evidence matrix feature was also added to the network. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: Documentation for new phase plans was added to the blockchain network, and durability checks were introduced. The SDK added user‑list overrides and role seeds, and a third‑party resolution update was made. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: A merge fix was applied and tests were added to align marker handling and prototype a parallel nonce feature. Repositories: SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Diagnostic prints were added and enhanced in the wallet verification component. Repositories: GeniusWallet.
